record.original_question: For the sequence A057163 arising from Emeric Deutsch's combinatorial construction on Dyck paths and listed in the paper as 0,1,3,2,8,7,6,5,4,22,21,20,18,17,…, determine what underlying combinatorial mechanism produces the observed graph structure in the associated 4-regular graphs.

evidence.quote: A057163 starts 0, 1, 3, 2, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 22, 21, 20, 18, 17, . . . . This sequence is related to a combinatorial construction due to Emeric Deutsch [3] regarding Dyck paths.
Most of these observations will be purely empirical – thus, we effectively list a large number of open problems: prove that said sequence indeed exhibits the observed type of structure.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $a:\mathbb{Z}_{\ge 0}\to\mathbb{Z}_{\ge 0}$ be the involution on nonnegative integers whose initial values are
$$a(0),a(1),a(2),\dots = 0,1,3,2,8,7,6,5,4,22,21,20,18,17,\dots,$$
defined by Deutsch's combinatorial construction on Dyck paths: encode $n$ as a Dyck path via the standard bijection between nonnegative integers and Dyck paths (ordered by length and then lexicographically), apply Deutsch's involution on Dyck paths (which reflects the path through the bijection that exchanges the roles of the two step types in a specified recursive manner), and let $a(n)$ be the index of the resulting path.

For each integer $N\ge 1$, construct a graph $G_N$ on the vertex set $\{0,1,\dots,N-1\}$ as follows: for every vertex $n$, place edges between $n$ and certain canonically chosen "neighbors" determined by simple successor/predecessor operations together with the involution $a$, so that $G_N$ is $4$-regular (specifically, the edges from $n$ go to the four images of $n$ under the maps $n\mapsto a(n+1)$, $n\mapsto a(n-1)$, $n\mapsto a(n)+1$, $n\mapsto a(n)-1$, with appropriate boundary conventions).

Identify and prove the underlying combinatorial mechanism that explains the structural patterns (cycle lengths, connected component sizes, automorphism orbits, and local neighborhood shapes) observed empirically in the family of $4$-regular graphs $\{G_N\}_{N\ge 1}$ associated with this sequence.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is presented as an empirically observed phenomenon, with the explicit acknowledgment that the underlying mechanism producing the graph structure has not been proved. No published resolution explaining the 4-regular graph structure arising from A057163 / Deutsch's Dyck-path involution was located via search.

status_evidence.title: OEIS A057163
status_evidence.snippet: Signature-permutation of a Catalan automorphism induced by Deutsch's 1998 bijection on Dyck paths.
status_evidence.claim: A057163 is the involution on nonnegative integers induced by Deutsch's bijection on Dyck paths; no statement there resolves the graph-structure question.
